blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-103-0011 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-103-8867 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email customercare@ucobankonline.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.ucobankonline.in and use the card block/hotlist option.

Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mobfin.ucobank.mbanking | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/uco-bank-mobile/id1205654706
